name: Agaricus bisporus

ecology.substrate: composted litter and manure; wild under cypress and on coastal litter

notes: The most cultivated mushroom; a fluffy front that is reported (unchecked) to form strands behind it. Reported (unchecked) to fruit in repeating flushes about a week apart and to need a casing layer and bacteria to fruit; water flow in its single hyphae is calculated at 50 um/s (research/04 [7]).

tip_speed.note: about 5 mm/day in sterile compost (7.2 mm/day in compost pre-grown with Scytalidium; 2.7 rising to 5.3 mm/day on agar at 24 C); temperature of the compost figure not in the snippet

uptake_rate.note: tuning value tied to tip speed

t_opt.note: optimum about 25 to 26 C, falls off above 28 C; research/06 [13][28] gives 24 C; snippets

cold_drop.note: initials stop at about 2 mm unless the temperature falls to about 16 C; taken from the 25 C optimum used here
